name: Sniper bot 0x76577603 lets anyone pull its owner's USDT and approve it to any target
summary: The unverified sniper bot's 0x0a8fe064(target, from, ?, amount, ?) has no caller check: it pulls amount USDT from `from` into the bot with transferFrom, approves target for the bot's USDT balance and calls target.Sell(amount, 1). The attacker's contract called it with itself as target and the bot's owner 0x637b935c, which had approved the bot, as `from`, then in Sell transferred the approved 20,000.01 USDT from the bot to the attacker.
notes: Mechanism from the exploit trace, as the bot is unverified. Victim is the bot's deployer and owner 0x637b935c, whose USDT approval to the bot was spent; the DeFiHackLabs header's ~1,300 USDC understates the 20,000.01 USDT that moved (6 decimals).

campaign.mjs from the bot's creation to the chain head finds only the owner's own test call (0xb6e34c20, 0.01 USDT, block 11403086) before the anchor and no later call; the bot made no other transaction and its code never changed.
Loss is the owner's USDT outflow, priced by loss.mjs.
